تختلبين (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِبِينَ (taḵtalibīna) /tax.ta.li.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# تُخْتَلَبِينَ (tuḵtalabīna) /tux.ta.la.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
